accepted_evidence.display_name: 半导体设备ETF（561980）海外开盘定价残差证据
accepted_evidence.formal_use: At the A-share open, compare actual opening gap with the fixed historical transmission estimate from the latest fully completed SOX/NDX cash session; use the signed residual only as a strengthening/weakening input to the existing opportunity and risk-return judgment.
accepted_evidence.boundary: Positive residual means relative underpricing versus the historical transmission estimate, not a buy trigger. No cross-ETF generalization. The fixed calibration cannot be silently refit in production.
accepted_evidence.primary_uncertainty: Single-object selection after broader cross-market screening creates extra selection-bias risk; use lower confidence than the cross-sectional selling-exhaustion evidence.

accepted_evidence.display_name: 缩量下跌但收离低点证据
accepted_evidence.formal_use: Use a completed daily bar showing a decline, low volume relative to the ETF's prior 20-day average and the historical low-volume regime, while closing materially off the daily low, as evidence that selling pressure may be exhausting; combine with trend, intraday path, acceptance and risk-reward.
accepted_evidence.boundary: This is a selling-exhaustion candidate, not proof of reversal and not a mechanical buy signal. High-volume demand/close-high did not retain incremental information after matched controls and is not converted.

accepted_evidence.display_name: 融资扩张×ETF相对反馈证据
accepted_evidence.formal_use: When the already validated 5-day margin-balance evidence is expanding, use the prior completed day's ETF return relative to the same-day ETF-universe median as a conditional persistence input for the validated ETF set.
accepted_evidence.boundary: Margin contraction only means this interaction is inactive; it is not a bearish signal. Do not mechanically buy relative winners. 588000 has the cleanest cross-fold result; other converted ETFs retain heterogeneous confidence.

rejected_evidence.reason: After replacing the initial over-tight event definition with 60-trading-day rolling PIT thresholds, weak-market resilience did not retain stable 3/5/10-day incremental information across folds.
After tightening the gate so positive high-dispersion migration and improvement versus lower dispersion must occur in the same folds, the apparent pass disappeared.

conclusion: Three scoped evidence families pass MASTER 8.1 formal conversion review: 561980 opening-pricing residual as lower-confidence single-object continuous evidence; completed-bar selling-exhaustion evidence as the strongest cross-sectional result; and margin-expansion-conditioned ETF relative feedback for the validated ETF subset, strongest in 588000. Weak-market resilience and dispersion-conditioned migration remain research-only/rejected. None can independently generate risk permission, Trial/Confirm, amount, sell quantity or orders.
review_boundary: Conversion authorizes evidence consumption only through the existing research execution bridge and existing buy/sell chains. It creates no new lifecycle, permission, score, amount tier or automatic trading path.
